title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1982-09-21
lineage: Dat -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy NYC show featuring a smoking Playin’ > Crazy Fingers opener, West LA Fadeaway and High Time.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its clear, crisp soundboard quality, making the performance easy to enjoy. The concert shines with an explosive Playin' > Crazy Fingers opening, a funky West LA Fadeaway, a soaring High Time and a shredding Big River, delivering consistently high energy throughout. While some note it sits just below the absolute peak of Fall ’82, it remains a solid, highly enjoyable show.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews consistently rate the show 4‑5 stars and highlight strong musical moments with no recording complaints; weighting gives a high overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers repeatedly mention clear, nice sound with no noted dropouts or mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A powerful opener (Playin' into Crazy Fingers) sets the tone, followed by a funky West LA and classic High Time, keeping momentum high through the set.
